package.name: omada-ui-kit
package.description: Omada Controller v6.3 React UI component library (Ant Design 6 + Design Tokens + Figma Assets + Single-file HTML standalone bundle)

components.name: hasOmadaIcon
components.description: Checks whether an icon slug exists in the bundled Figma icon library.

components.name: hasOmadaIllustration
components.description: Checks whether an illustration slug exists in the bundled Figma illustration library.

components.name: hasOmadaProductImage
components.description: Checks whether a hardware product slug exists in the bundled Figma product library.

components.name: OmadaLogo
components.description: Official Omada wordmark SVG exported from Figma node `25947:13603`. Uses `currentColor` so it adapts to Top Bar (`#FFFFFF`) and light/dark surfaces.

components.name: SBrandAsset
components.description: Official Omada wordmark, app icon, and OAuth brand asset backed by `src/assets/brand/`.

components.name: SClientIcon
components.description: Theme-aware Omada client device / OS / vendor icon backed by `src/assets/clients/{light,dark}/`.

components.name: SDeviceIcon
components.description: Semantic device type badge icon for Omada gateways, switches, APs, OLTs, cameras, NVRs, and clients.

components.name: SIcon
components.description: Official Omada SVG icon component backed by the 586 Figma icons in `src/assets/icons/`. Monochrome icons inherit `currentColor`; multi-color icons preserve Figma fills.

components.name: SIllustration
components.description: Theme-aware Omada illustration backed by `src/assets/illustrations/{light,dark}/`. Automatically selects the dark variant in Dark Mode when available.

components.name: SProductImage
components.description: Theme-aware Omada hardware product thumbnail backed by `src/assets/products/{light,dark}/`.

components.name: SBarChart
components.description: Omada Bar chart preset supporting vertical, stacked, and horizontal layouts with 5-tick (or 6-tick percentage) axis scaling, loading skeleton, and empty state.

components.name: SChart
components.description: ECharts 5 chart wrapper pre-configured with Omada's 20-color categorical palette, `Manrope` typography, dashed gridlines, Light/Dark live theme sync, `ResizeObserver`, loading skeleton, and `<SEmpty>` empty state.

components.name: SDonutChart
components.description: Omada Donut ring chart preset with optional center KPI metric overlay, interactive legend, loading skeleton, and empty state.

components.name: SLineChart
components.description: Omada multi-series Line / Area chart preset with 5-tick default or 6-tick percentage Y-axis, gradient area fill, interactive legend toggling, loading skeleton, and empty state.

props.name: percentage
props.description: Fixes Y-axis to 0%–100% with 6 ticks (`0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100`).

components.name: SSparkChart
components.description: Compact dashboard widget spark chart featuring strictly 2 Y-axis ticks (`min` and `max`), supporting `area`, `line`, and `bar` modes.

props.name: showAxisTicks
props.description: Shows strictly 2 Y-axis ticks (`min` and `max`) per Omada widget spec.

components.name: SAvatar
components.description: Omada Avatar component supporting `20px` (`xs`), `24px` (`sm`), `32px` (`md`), and `48px` (`lg`) sizes, image with graceful fallback, initials, guest/authenticated states, and optional status indicator.

props.name: size
props.description: Named Omada presets (`xs`: 20px, `sm`: 24px, `md`: 32px, `lg`: 48px) or numeric px.

props.name: name
props.description: User display name; renders initials when no `src` or `icon` is given.

props.name: guest
props.description: Render neutral guest avatar state instead of authenticated brand tint.

props.name: status
props.description: Optional presence dot rendered at the bottom-right corner.

components.name: SAvatarGroup
components.description: Omada Avatar stack wrapper using AntD 6 `max` overflow popover config.

props.name: maxCount
props.description: Maximum avatars shown before collapsing into a `+N` overflow badge (AntD 6 `max.count`).

components.name: SBadge
components.description: Omada Badge supporting `20px`-tall capsule counts (`99+` overflow), standalone dots, and semantic status indicators (`success`, `warning`, `error`, `processing`, `default`).

props.name: size
props.description: AntD 6 size (`'small' | 'medium'`; never deprecated `'default'`).

props.name: status
props.description: Semantic status dot mode (`success`, `warning`, `error`, `processing`, `default`).

props.name: tone
props.description: Count/dot semantic color tone when `color` is not manually provided.

components.name: SCard
components.description: Omada surface card (`#FFFFFF` light / `#1A1A1A` dark, 8px radius, 1px hairline border).

components.name: SCollapse
components.description: Omada Collapse / Accordion panel supporting `default`, `card`, and `ghost` variants, header status/extra slots, smooth chevron rotation, and Light/Dark parity.

props.name: size
props.description: AntD 6 size (`'small' | 'medium' | 'large'`).

components.name: SCustomTag
components.description: 24px neutral tag for multi-select values and editable tag lists.

components.name: SDescriptions
components.description: Omada Descriptions component supporting `bordered`, `filled`, and `borderless` variants, `horizontal` (`200px` fixed label column) and `vertical` layouts, and Light/Dark tokens.

props.name: size
props.description: AntD 6 size (`'small' | 'medium' | 'large'`; never deprecated `'default'`).

props.name: labelWidth
props.description: Fixed label column width in horizontal mode (defaults to `200` per Omada Figma spec).

components.name: SEditableCell
components.description: Compact `28px`-high inline editable table cell supporting both single-cell click-to-edit (Enter/Save/Cancel) and controlled `editing` mode for batch row editing.

props.name: value
props.description: Current committed cell value (or live value in controlled batch mode).

props.name: onSave
props.description: Invoked when the user commits an edit in single-cell mode (Enter, Save button, or blur).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Immediate change callback for controlled / batch row editing.

props.name: editing
props.description: Controlled editing state (set `true` on all cells in a row for batch editing).

props.name: defaultEditing
props.description: Initial uncontrolled editing state.

props.name: onEditingChange
props.description: Notifies when single-cell editing starts or exits.

props.name: type
props.description: Input control variant rendered during edit mode.

props.name: options
props.description: Select options when `type="select"`.

props.name: showActions
props.description: Render explicit Save / Cancel icon buttons next to the input (defaults to `true` when `editing` is uncontrolled).

props.name: saveOnBlur
props.description: Commit on blur instead of requiring explicit Enter / Save click.

props.name: validate
props.description: Optional synchronous validator returning an error message string.

props.name: renderDisplay
props.description: Custom display renderer when not editing.

props.name: inputWidth
props.description: Optional width constraint for the inline editor (e.g. `254`).

components.name: SKpiCard
components.description: Compact Omada KPI metric tile with tabular numerals, optional icon, and breakdown meta line.

components.name: SProgress
components.description: Omada-styled Progress component supporting linear (`6px` pill bar), circular (`112px` ring), all 5 Figma visual states (`normal`, `active`, `success`, `warning`, `exception`), `indeterminate` animation, and a `variant="budget"` PoE power budget preset.

props.name: status
props.description: All 5 Figma visual states: `normal`, `active`, `success`, `warning`, `exception`

props.name: variant
props.description: Standard progress bar/ring (`default`) or resource/PoE power budget readout (`budget`)

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Animated indeterminate linear progress bar (ignores `percent`)

props.name: label
props.description: Optional header label rendered above linear progress or budget bar

props.name: used
props.description: Used resource value for `variant="budget"` (e.g., `186.4`)

props.name: total
props.description: Total capacity value for `variant="budget"` (e.g., `384`)

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit suffix for `variant="budget"` readout (defaults to `'W'`)

props.name: warningThreshold
props.description: Percentage threshold switching `budget` status to `warning` (defaults to `80`)

props.name: dangerThreshold
props.description: Percentage threshold switching `budget` status to `exception` (defaults to `95`)

props.name: strokeHeight
props.description: Linear stroke thickness in px (defaults to `6` matching Figma spec)

components.name: STable
components.description: Omada Data Table wrapping AntD `Table` with an integrated toolbar (tabs, search, filters, column settings popover, density toggle, slide-in batch action bar), expandable row styling, and Omada's `Showing X-Y of Z records` footer.

props.name: columnSettings
props.description: Show a column visibility checklist popover button in the toolbar.

props.name: densityToggle
props.description: Show a `'default' | 'compact'` row density switcher in the toolbar.

props.name: density
props.description: Controlled table density (`'default' | 'compact'`).

props.name: defaultDensity
props.description: Initial uncontrolled density when `densityToggle` is enabled.

props.name: onDensityChange
props.description: Callback invoked when density changes via `densityToggle`.

components.name: STag
components.description: Omada status/category tag (`20px` height, `3px` radius, `subtle` or `solid` fill).

components.name: STile
components.description: Selectable Omada option tile (`Normal`, `Hover`, `Selected` green border + corner checkmark, `Disabled`) usable standalone or inside `<STileGroup>`.

props.name: value
props.description: Option identifier when used inside `<STileGroup>`.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled selection state when used standalone.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Default uncontrolled selection state when used standalone.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Change callback when used standalone.

components.name: STileGroup
components.description: Single- or multi-select Omada option tile group supporting declarative `options` or composable `<STile>` children.

components.name: EMULATOR_NAV_GROUPS
components.description: Exact Omada Controller v6.3.0.34 sidebar hierarchy: 5 Title-Case sections and 13 navigation items.

components.name: LagGlyph
components.description: Link Aggregation (LAG) stacked-port badge glyph.

components.name: PortBadgeTile
components.description: Single physical port square tile used in port graphics, connection rows, and port tables.

components.name: PortStatusLegend
components.description: 10-item horizontal port speed & attribute legend matching Omada Controller v6.3.

components.name: resolveConnectedProductSlug
components.description: Resolves a valid `SProductImage` slug for a connected neighbor device.

components.name: SApDistributionRuler
components.description: RSSI AP Distribution ruler (`-90dBm` to `-30`) with rainbow signal-quality gradient bar, 5 dBm tick marks, and circular AP device cluster markers with green count badges.

props.name: clusters
props.description: AP signal distribution clusters plotted along the `-90dBm .. -30dBm` ruler.

props.name: minDbm
props.description: Minimum scale value in dBm (defaults to `-90`).

props.name: maxDbm
props.description: Maximum scale value in dBm (defaults to `-30`).

props.name: step
props.description: Step between ruler tick marks (defaults to `5`).

components.name: SCategoryKpiCarousel
components.description: Horizontal scrollable KPI category strip with `<` / `>` scroll arrows, active `#00A870` border + subtle tint highlight, and Light/Dark theme support.

props.name: items
props.description: Category KPI cards rendered horizontally inside the carousel.

props.name: activeKey
props.description: Controlled active category key.

props.name: defaultActiveKey
props.description: Uncontrolled initial active category key (defaults to `'overview'`).

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fired when a category card is selected.

components.name: SChannelUtilization
components.description: Multi-band wireless Channel Utilization mini-bar chart across `2.4 GHz`, `5 GHz`, and `6 GHz` with color-coded Low / Medium / High utilization levels and band underline labels.

props.name: bands
props.description: Radio band groups (`2.4 GHz`, `5 GHz`, `6 GHz`) rendered side by side.

components.name: SClientOverviewStrip
components.description: 4-column client overview KPI strip displayed above the Emulator Clients toolbar. Shows client category artwork (`SClientIcon`) paired with count and category label.

props.name: items
props.description: 4 horizontal client overview KPI blocks (`Online Clients`, `Mobile`, `Others`, `Office`).

props.name: activeKey
props.description: Optional currently active category filter key.

props.name: onItemClick
props.description: Optional click handler invoked when a KPI block is clicked.

components.name: SDeviceHealthSummary
components.description: 4-column device health summary strip displayed above the Emulator Devices toolbar. Shows category icon, health score or `Good / Fair / Poor / No Data` counts, and a 200x4px segmented bar.

props.name: items
props.description: Health summary items across device categories (defaults to Gateway / Switches / APs / OLTs).

props.name: onCategoryClick
props.description: Optional click handler when a category block is clicked.

components.name: SDevicePortGraphic
components.description: Interactive physical port strip for Omada Quick Properties (`mode="compact"`) and Expanded Manage Device Ports view (`mode="full"` with floating connected device thumbnails).

props.name: ports
props.description: Ordered list of physical ports on the device.

props.name: mode
props.description: `compact` renders 32px tiles + Used Port header; `full` renders 40px tiles + optional connected devices + legend.

props.name: showConnectedDevices
props.description: Displays floating connected device thumbnails with vertical stem lines above connected ports in `full` mode.

props.name: showHeader
props.description: Controls the `Used Port: X/Y` + info icon header row (defaults to `true` in `compact` mode).

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Controls the 10-item horizontal port legend below the graphic (defaults to `true` in `full` mode).

props.name: usedPorts
props.description: Override count of used ports shown in compact header.

props.name: totalPorts
props.description: Override count of total ports shown in compact header.

props.name: selectedPort
props.description: Currently selected port number for table/graphic synchronization.

props.name: onSelectPort
props.description: Callback fired when a port tile is clicked.

components.name: SDeviceStatus
components.description: Semantic network device connectivity/provisioning indicator with colored status dot.

components.name: SDonutSummaryCard
components.description: Omada Donut Summary Card pairing a ring chart with centered metric overlay and either vertical interactive breakdown rows (`Application Analytics`) or a compact side-by-side legend (`Reports`).

props.name: title
props.description: Card header title.

props.name: titleIcon
props.description: Optional icon rendered before `title`.

props.name: centerValue
props.description: Primary metric centered inside the donut ring (e.g. `"58.33 MB"` or `"4"`).

props.name: centerLabel
props.description: Secondary subtitle centered below `centerValue` (e.g. `"Traffic"` or `"Total"`).

props.name: data
props.description: Breakdown items powering both the donut slices and the item/legend list.

props.name: layout
props.description: `'vertical'` stacks the donut above clickable breakdown rows (Application Analytics). `'horizontal'` aligns the donut on the left and a compact legend on the right (Reports).

props.name: legendColumns
props.description: Number of columns for horizontal legend layout (`1` or `2`).

props.name: donutSize
props.description: Donut canvas diameter in pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: ECharts pie inner/outer radius percentages.

props.name: closable
props.description: Show a close (`×`) button in the card header.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Callback invoked when the close (`×`) button is clicked.

props.name: closeAriaLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the close button.

props.name: onItemClick
props.description: Callback invoked when a clickable breakdown row is activated.

props.name: extra
props.description: Optional extra header element rendered when `closable` is false.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Optional accessible label or test id on the card root.

components.name: SEmulatorShell
components.description: Omada Controller v6.3.0.34 authentic emulator layout shell: - Scoped `.omada-emulator-root` Light/Dark surface & color palette - `56px` Top Bar with left controller context, centered Omada wordmark, and right utility controls - `216px` / `52px` borderless collapsible sidebar with site pill selector and 5 Title-Case sections - Right-edge floating `<||` quick-drawer handle

props.name: activeKey
props.description: Active navigation item key (e.g. `'dashboard'`, `'devices'`).

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Invoked when a sidebar navigation item is selected.

props.name: navGroups
props.description: Optional navigation groups override; defaults to `EMULATOR_NAV_GROUPS`.

props.name: controllerName
props.description: Controller / organization name displayed on the left of the Top Bar.

props.name: sites
props.description: Available site options shown in the sidebar site pill dropdown.

props.name: activeSite
props.description: Controlled active site key or label.

props.name: onSiteChange
props.description: Invoked when a site is picked from the site pill dropdown.

props.name: userName
props.description: Accessible user display name for the top-right avatar badge.

props.name: onSearchClick
props.description: Invoked when the top-right Search icon button is clicked.

props.name: onRefresh
props.description: Invoked when the top-right Refresh icon button is clicked.

props.name: onOpenShowcase
props.description: Invoked when `Component Library` is chosen from the `More` menu.

props.name: onMoreSelect
props.description: Invoked when an item in the `More` dropdown menu is clicked.

props.name: onToggleQuickDrawer
props.description: Invoked when the right-edge `<||` floating quick-drawer handle is clicked.

props.name: showQuickDrawerHandle
props.description: Whether to show the right-edge floating quick-drawer handle (default `true`).

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Controlled sidebar collapsed state.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Initial uncontrolled sidebar collapsed state.

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Invoked when the sidebar collapse button toggles state.

props.name: embedded
props.description: Bounded container mode for embedded showcase previews.

components.name: SfpGlyph
components.description: Crisp white/monochrome SFP fiber transceiver module icon matching Omada Controller v6.3.

components.name: SHealthGauge
components.description: 180-degree Omada Network Health semi-circle gauge featuring outer `0..100` ticks, rounded emerald progress arc, centered large numeric readout, and info tooltip.

props.name: score
props.description: Current site/device health score from `0` to `maxScore`.

props.name: maxScore
props.description: Maximum gauge score (defaults to `100`).

props.name: label
props.description: Subtitle beneath the large numeric score.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Optional tooltip text displayed on the info icon next to `label`.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the gauge SVG in pixels (defaults to `248`).

components.name: SHealthRadar
components.description: 4-axis concentric circular radar visualization (`Wi-Fi`, `Client`, `WAN`, `Device`) with translucent emerald polygon fill and vertex markers.

props.name: wifi
props.description: Wi-Fi dimension health score (`0..maxValue`).

props.name: client
props.description: Client dimension health score (`0..maxValue`).

props.name: wan
props.description: WAN dimension health score (`0..maxValue`).

props.name: device
props.description: Device dimension health score (`0..maxValue`).

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Maximum dimension scale (defaults to `100`).

props.name: wanTooltip
props.description: Optional tooltip shown on the WAN `(i)` icon.

props.name: width
props.description: SVG width/height square box in pixels (defaults to `252` wide × `180` tall).

components.name: SHealthTrendBar
components.description: Multi-row 24h Network Health Trend timeline rendering ~96 thin vertical ticks per row across `Device`, `Client`, `Wi-Fi`, and `WAN` dimensions.

props.name: rows
props.description: Dimension rows (`Device`, `Client`, `Wi-Fi`, `WAN`).

props.name: tickLabels
props.description: Optional labels per tick index for hover inspection.

components.name: SPortPanel
components.description: Interactive Switch / Gateway physical port matrix matching Omada Figma port speed colors (11 states). Supports single-row or double-row (odd top / even bottom) layout, port badges, tooltips, and selection.

components.name: SSettingsInfoBanner
components.description: Soft blue `#F0F5FA` (Light) / `#1D2939` (Dark) informational banner for Omada settings pages.

props.name: children
props.description: Numbered or rich informational items displayed inside the soft blue banner.

components.name: SSettingsPageShell
components.description: Reusable Omada Controller v6.3 configuration page container providing: - `20px` title header + optional top-right circular green `(?)` Help trigger - Optional `18px` underline sub-tab bar - Clean borderless content workspace + optional dirty-state sticky `Apply` / `Cancel` footer bar

props.name: title
props.description: Optional 20px page heading (omitted on tab-first pages like LAN).

props.name: showHelp
props.description: Optional top-right circular green `(?)` Help icon (defaults to `true`).

props.name: helpTitle
props.description: Heading inside the Help popover when `(?)` is clicked.

props.name: helpDescription
props.description: Body description inside the Help popover when `(?)` is clicked.

props.name: onHelpClick
props.description: Optional click callback overriding default Help popover behavior.

props.name: headerExtra
props.description: Extra controls placed left of the `(?)` Help button in the header bar.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Optional underline sub-tabs (`18px` Omada tab bar).

props.name: activeTab
props.description: Controlled active tab key.

props.name: defaultActiveTab
props.description: Initial uncontrolled active tab key.

props.name: onTabChange
props.description: Invoked when an underline sub-tab is clicked.

props.name: tabAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible `aria-label` for the underline sub-tabs tablist.

props.name: dirty
props.description: Shows the sticky bottom `Apply` / `Cancel` bar when `true`.

props.name: onApply
props.description: Callback invoked when the sticky `Apply` button is clicked.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Callback invoked when the sticky `Cancel` button is clicked.

props.name: applyText
props.description: Custom primary action label (defaults to `'Apply'`).

props.name: cancelText
props.description: Custom secondary action label (defaults to `'Cancel'`).

props.name: applying
props.description: Loading state for the sticky `Apply` button.

props.name: applyDisabled
props.description: Disables the sticky `Apply` button while keeping `Cancel` active.

props.name: footerExtra
props.description: Optional auxiliary content shown on the right of the sticky footer bar.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Optional data-testid applied to the root shell container.

components.name: SSettingsRow
components.description: Horizontal Omada settings field row (`210px` left label / `350px` right filled control).

props.name: label
props.description: Left column label (`210px` default width).

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Optional tooltip shown via inline `(i)` icon next to the label.

props.name: labelWidth
props.description: Width of left label column in px (defaults to `210`).

props.name: controlWidth
props.description: Width constraint for the control column (`350` default, or `'auto' | 'full'`).

props.name: hint
props.description: Optional muted helper description rendered directly below the control.

props.name: after
props.description: Optional trailing text or element rendered immediately right of the control box.

props.name: align
props.description: Vertical alignment of label relative to control (`'center'` or `'start'`).

components.name: SSettingsSection
components.description: Borderless Omada settings section block with optional hairline top divider and `16px` title.

props.name: title
props.description: Section title (`16px` medium weight).

props.name: description
props.description: Optional muted subtitle rendered below the section title.

props.name: extra
props.description: Optional right-aligned header action slot.

props.name: dividerTop
props.description: Renders a hairline horizontal divider above this section.

components.name: STerminalConsole
components.description: Reusable Omada v6.3 split diagnostic terminal console featuring: - Header bar with title, right-aligned filled search input, and Clear / Download / `A+` controls - Left `Device List` rail (`200px` wide) displaying active session/output device pills - Right dark monospace terminal surface (`#242424`) with centered empty prompt and optional interactive CLI input

props.name: title
props.description: Section title on the left of the header bar (e.g. `'Device Output'` or `'Sessions'`).

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder for the right-aligned filled search field.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Centered muted message displayed inside the dark terminal box when empty.

props.name: sessions
props.description: Diagnostic device outputs or interactive CLI sessions.

props.name: activeKey
props.description: Controlled active session key.

props.name: defaultActiveKey
props.description: Initial active session key for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: onSelectSession
props.description: Callback fired when a device in `Device List` is clicked.

props.name: onCloseSession
props.description: Optional callback fired when the close icon on a device pill is clicked.

props.name: searchQuery
props.description: Controlled search query string.

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Callback fired when the search input changes.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Callback fired when the Clear (broom) icon button is clicked.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Callback fired when the Download icon button is clicked.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Enables an interactive CLI command input prompt inside the terminal body.

props.name: onSubmitCommand
props.description: Callback fired when the user submits a CLI command in interactive mode.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum height in pixels for the split `Device List` + dark terminal body.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Optional test identifier on the root container.

components.name: STopologyCanvas
components.description: Interactive Omada v6.3 Network Topology Canvas (`Dashboard -> Topology`). Renders hierarchical Gateway -> Switch -> AP -> Client connections with curved Bezier edges, port/speed badges, green collapsible subtree hubs, search/health dimming, horizontal/vertical layout toggle, zoom/pan, and node click-to-inspect callbacks.

props.name: root
props.description: Root topology tree node (defaults to Headquarters Building hierarchy).

props.name: layout
props.description: Layout orientation (`'horizontal'` left-to-right or `'vertical'` top-to-bottom).

props.name: onLayoutChange
props.description: Invoked when user toggles layout mode via bottom-left control.

props.name: searchQuery
props.description: Filter query matched against node name, IP, model, or MAC.

props.name: healthFilter
props.description: Optional health bucket highlight filter.

props.name: networkFilter
props.description: Optional network filter value (`'all'` shows all).

props.name: ssidFilter
props.description: Optional SSID filter value (`'all'` shows all).

props.name: displayOptions
props.description: Display toggles controlled from top-bar Display popover.

props.name: onOpenDeviceByName
props.description: Invoked when a device node is clicked (opens DevicePropertiesDrawer).

props.name: onSelectNode
props.description: Invoked when any node (device, client, controller, internet) is clicked.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of canvas container (defaults to `580`).

components.name: SAlert
components.description: Omada borderless 12%-tinted banner alert (`6px` radius, `12px 16px` padding).

components.name: SDrawer
components.description: Omada slide-over Drawer (`sm`: 480px, `md`: 640px, `lg`: 880px) supporting a rich header slot with subtitle, status badge, tabs, and loading skeleton.

props.name: loading
props.description: Displays a skeleton placeholder inside the drawer body while data loads

components.name: SDrawerFooter
components.description: Standardized Omada drawer footer bar for `SDrawer`'s `footer` prop or sticky bottom body placement.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Make footer sticky inside scrollable drawer body (adds top border & surface fill)

components.name: SEmpty
components.description: Clean Omada empty state placeholder for tables, drawers, and sub-panels. Defaults to the official theme-aware Figma `no-data` illustration unless overridden via `icon` or `illustration={false}`.

components.name: SInfoDialog
components.description: Status/result information dialog using official Figma status icons or illustrations, supporting centered result layouts, progress content, and Stop/OK actions.

props.name: status
props.description: Semantic status icon state matching Figma Dialog specs

props.name: illustration
props.description: Optional Figma illustration slug (`<SIllustration />`) displayed above the title

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon overriding the default status icon

props.name: layout

components.description: Omada Steps (`3:64441`) supporting horizontal, vertical, navigation, dot, and loading states using AntD 6 `orientation`, `titlePlacement`, and `content` APIs.

props.name: items
props.description: Step definitions rendered in sequence.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout orientation (AntD 6 `orientation`; defaults to `'horizontal'`).

props.name: type
props.description: Visual style (`default`, `navigation`, `inline`, or `dot`).

props.name: titlePlacement
props.description: Title/content placement relative to icon (`horizontal` or `vertical`).

props.name: size
props.description: Step size (`small` or `medium`; never passes deprecated `size="default"`).

props.name: loading
props.description: Displays a spinning loader on the active (`current`) step item.

components.name: STabs
components.description: Omada Tabs supporting: - `line`: primary page navigation underline tabs (`34px` height, `#00A870` indicator) - `capsule`: Omada green active capsule tabs (or `pill` rounded-full) - `segment`: neutral surface segmented switcher with optional legend dot

components.name: buildOmadaAntdTheme
components.description: Builds the Ant Design 5 ThemeConfig mapped from Omada semantic tokens.

components.name: OmadaProvider
components.description: Root theme & styling provider for Omada UI Kit. Syncs Light / Dark / System mode to `<html data-theme>` + `.dark` and wraps AntD 5 `<StyleProvider layer>`.

components.name: useOmadaTheme
components.description: Access current Omada theme mode (`light` | `dark` | `system`), resolved theme, and semantic tokens.
